proof_body:
by
  intro f g a u v hf hg hfa hga hv
  refine ⟨hg.eventually_ne hv, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.1 hf
  have h2 := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.1 hg
  refine (h1.div h2 hv).congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
  have hx' : x - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
  simp only [Pi.div_apply, slope_def_field, hfa, hga, sub_zero]
  exact div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hx' _ _
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a u v : ℝ), HasDerivAt f u a → HasDerivAt g v a → f a = 0 → g a = 0 → v ≠ 0 → (∀ᶠ x in nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ, g x ≠ 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds (u / v))
